translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Ögedei he campaigned as pacification commissioner, captured Xin'an and Henan, and for his service received a gold tiger tally and appointment as Campaigning Ten-thousand Households.

sentences.zh: 歲甲寅，以疾卒。

translations.literal: In the year jiayin he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness in 1254.

sentences.zh: 子脫察剌襲職。

translations.literal: His son Tuochala inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tuochala inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 歲己未，率兵渡江，破十字寨。

translations.literal: In the year jiwei he led troops across the river and broke Shizi Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In 1259 he led troops across the Yangtze and captured Shizi Stockade.

sentences.zh: 命其子重喜從行。

translations.literal: He ordered his son Zhongxi to follow on the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his son Zhongxi to accompany the campaign.

sentences.zh: 重喜率先引弓，射中敵兵，又多殺獲。

translations.literal: Zhongxi was first to draw the bow, shot and hit enemy soldiers, and killed and captured many more.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi was the first to draw his bow, struck enemy soldiers, and killed or captured many besides.

sentences.zh: 既而與敵兵戰於洋隘口，奪戰艦一，流矢中左足，勇氣愈倍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he fought enemy troops at Yangyikou, seized one war junk, was struck by a stray arrow in the left foot, and his courage doubled.
translations.idiomatic: He soon fought the enemy at Yangyikou, seized a war junk, took a stray arrow in the left foot, and fought with redoubled courage.

sentences.zh: 時世祖駐蹕洋隘口北，親勞之曰：「汝年幼能宣力如是，深可嘉尚。

translations.literal: At that time the Emperor was encamped north of Yangyikou and personally comforted him, saying, "Though you are young you can exert strength like this; it is deeply worthy of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was then encamped north of Yangyikou and personally praised him: "Though you are young, you have shown such strength — deeply admirable.

sentences.zh: 然繼今尤當勉之。

translations.literal: Yet hereafter you should strive all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Yet you must strive all the more hereafter.

sentences.zh: 」及脫察剌卒，以重喜襲職。

translations.literal: " When Tuochala died, Zhongxi inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuochala died, Zhongxi inherited the command.

sentences.zh: 中統三年，從征李亶有功。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong he followed the campaign against Li Tan with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1262 he distinguished himself in the campaign against Li Tan.

sentences.zh: 四年，以兵鎮莒州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he garrisoned troops at Juzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1263 he garrisoned troops at Juzhou.

sentences.zh: 至元二年，奉旨初築十字路城，以備守禦。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan by imperial decree he first built Shizi Road city for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In 1265 by imperial decree he first built the defensive city at Shizi Road.

sentences.zh: 重喜率兵南巡，為遊擊軍。

translations.literal: Zhongxi led troops on a southern patrol as a mobile strike force.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxi led troops on a southern patrol as a mobile strike force.

sentences.zh: 四年，從抄不花出征，至泗州北古城。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Chaobuhua on campaign to the old city north of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1267 he joined Chaobuhua's campaign to the old city north of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 時蔡千戶為敵兵所圍，重喜奮戰，救而出之。

translations.literal: At that time Chiliarch Cai was surrounded by enemy troops; Zhongxi fought fiercely and rescued him.
translations.idiomatic: When Chiliarch Cai was surrounded by the enemy, Zhongxi fought fiercely and rescued him.

sentences.zh: 五年，入覲。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he entered for audience.
translations.idiomatic: In 1268 he presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其功，賜白金、納失失段及金鞍弓矢等。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his merit and granted white gold, nashiji brocade, a gold saddle, bow and arrows, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his service and granted white gold, nashiji brocade, a gold saddle, bow and arrows, and comparable gifts.

sentences.zh: 十年，修正陽城。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he repaired Zhengyang city.
translations.idiomatic: In 1273 he repaired Zhengyang city.

sentences.zh: 明年，宋兵圍正陽，從戰敗之。

translations.literal: The following year Song troops besieged Zhengyang; he followed in battle and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when Song forces besieged Zhengyang, he joined the fighting and routed them.

sentences.zh: 十二年，從下漣海諸城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he followed in capturing the cities of Lianhai.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 he joined the capture of the cities of Lianhai.

sentences.zh: 俄奉旨率五千人從出征，道過衡陽店，與宋將李提轄等戰，大敗之，殺掠幾盡，遂駐兵瓜洲。

translations.literal: Soon by imperial decree he led five thousand men following on campaign; passing Hengyang Shop he fought Song commander Li Tixia and others, inflicted a great defeat, killed and plundered nearly all, and then encamped at Guazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he led five thousand men on campaign by imperial decree. Passing Hengyang Shop he fought Song commander Li Tixia and others, inflicted a crushing defeat, slaughtered nearly all, and encamped at Guazhou.

sentences.zh: 十三年夏六月，宋都統姜才領諸軍來圍城堡，敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer of the thirteenth year Song Commander Jiang Cai led all armies to besiege the fort and castle; [Zhongxi] defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1276, when Song Commander Jiang Cai besieged the fort, he routed the attackers.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，從兵襲擊李庭芝等於泰州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he followed troops in a surprise attack on Li Tingzhi and others at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he joined a surprise attack on Li Tingzhi and others at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，進昭勇大將軍、婺州路總管府達魯花赤，佩已降虎符。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to General of Manifest Courage and Darughachi of the Wuzhou Circuit General Administration Office, wearing a surrendered tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 he was promoted to General of Manifest Courage and military governor of Wuzhou, bearing a surrendered tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 子慶孫襲職，初授宣武將軍、管軍總管，鎮守安樂州。

translations.literal: His son Qingsun inherited the post, first appointed General of Manifest Martiality and Commander of Troops, garrisoning Anlezhou.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qingsun inherited the post, first appointed General of Manifest Martiality and troop commander, garrisoning Anlezhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年，移戍鎮江府。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to garrison Zhenjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 he was transferred to garrison Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 十八年，還鎮通州。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he returned to garrison Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1281 he returned to garrison Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年，進明威將軍。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to General of Bright Martiality.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 he was promoted to General of Bright Martiality.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，移鎮十字路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to garrison Shizi Road.
translations.idiomatic: In 1285 he was transferred to garrison Shizi Road.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，領諸翼軍鎮太湖，教習水戰。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he commanded all wing armies garrisoning Taihu and trained them in naval warfare.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 he commanded all wing armies garrisoning Lake Tai and trained them in naval warfare.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，從征爪哇，升昭勇大將軍、征行上萬戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he followed the campaign against Java and was promoted to General of Manifest Courage and Campaigning Senior Ten-thousand Households.
translations.idiomatic: In 1292 he joined the Java campaign and was promoted to General of Manifest Courage and senior campaigning ten-thousand households.

sentences.zh: 將行，有旨留之。

translations.literal: About to depart, there was an order to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: Just before departure an order recalled him.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1313.

sentences.zh: 子孛蘭奚襲。

translations.literal: His son Bolanxi inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Bolanxi inherited the post.

sentences.zh: ○直脫兒

translations.literal: ○ Zhituoer
translations.idiomatic: ○ Zhituoer

sentences.zh: 直脫兒，蒙古氏，父阿察兒，事太祖，為博兒赤。

translations.literal: Zhituoer was of the Mongol clan; his father Acha'er served the Great Khan as bo'urchi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhituoer was a Mongol; his father Acha'er had served Genghis Khan as a bo'urchi.

sentences.zh: 直脫兒從太宗征欽察、康裏、回回等部有功。

translations.literal: Zhituoer followed Emperor Taizong in campaigning against the Kipchak, Kangli, Muslim, and other tribes with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhituoer followed Emperor Ögedei in campaigns against the Kipchak, Kangli, Muslim, and other peoples with distinction.

sentences.zh: 四年，收河南、關西諸路，得民戶四萬餘，以屬莊聖皇太后，為脂粉絲線顏色戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he received Henan, Guanxi, and other circuits, obtaining more than forty thousand civilian households, which he placed under Empress Zhuangsheng as households for rouge, silk thread, and dyes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he subdued Henan, Guanxi, and other regions, registering more than forty thousand civilian households placed under Empress Zhuangsheng as producers of cosmetics, silk thread, and dyes.

sentences.zh: 八年，建織染七局於涿州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he established seven weaving and dyeing bureaus at Zhuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he established seven weaving and dyeing bureaus at Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，改涿州路，以直脫兒為達魯花赤。

translations.literal: The following year Zhuozhou was made a circuit and Zhituoer was appointed Darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Zhuozhou was elevated to a circuit and Zhituoer was appointed its military governor.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 子哈蘭術襲，佩虎符。

translations.literal: His son Halanshu inherited, wearing a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: His son Halanshu inherited the post, bearing a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 李亶叛，世祖命領諸萬戶為監戰達魯花赤以討之。

translations.literal: When Li Tan rebelled, Emperor Shizu ordered him to lead all ten-thousand households as campaign-supervising Darughachi to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Tan rebelled, Kublai Khan ordered him to lead all ten-thousand households as campaign-supervising military governor to suppress the revolt.

sentences.zh: 有功，授解萬戶翼監戰領軍。

translations.literal: With merit he was appointed Campaign-supervising Commander of the Jie Ten-thousand Households Wing.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was appointed campaign-supervising commander of the Jie Ten-thousand Households Wing.

sentences.zh: 遷益都路蒙古萬戶，監戰密州，沒於軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Mongol Ten-thousand Households of Yidu Circuit, campaign-supervised Mizhou, and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to commander of the Yidu Mongol ten-thousand households, supervised the campaign at Mizhou, and died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 從子忽剌出襲職，授昭勇大將軍。

translations.literal: His nephew Hulachu inherited the post and was appointed General of Manifest Courage.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Hulachu inherited the post and was appointed General of Manifest Courage.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，攻宋六安軍，有功。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan he attacked Song Liu'an Army with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 he distinguished himself in the attack on Song Liu'an Army.

sentences.zh: 行中書省命領諸軍戰艦沖宋軍，宋軍敗，有旨褒賞。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat ordered him to lead all military war junks to charge Song troops; Song troops were defeated and there was an order to commend and reward.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat ordered him to lead the war fleet in a charge against Song forces. After the Song fleet was routed, an order commended and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 九月，師次安慶。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the army halted at Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the army halted at Anqing.

sentences.zh: 忽剌出及參政董文炳領山東諸軍順流東下，至丁家洲，遇宋臣夏貴、孫虎臣等，戰江中，宋軍大敗，擒其將校三十七人、軍五千餘、船四十艘。

translations.literal: Hulachu and Vice Councillor Dong Wenbing led Shandong forces downstream to Dingjiazhou, encountered Song ministers Xia Gui and Sun Huchen and others, fought in the river; Song troops were greatly defeated; thirty-seven of their officers, more than five thousand soldiers, and forty ships were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Hulachu and Vice Councillor Dong Wenbing led Shandong forces downstream to Dingjiazhou, encountered Song ministers Xia Gui and Sun Huchen, fought on the river, and inflicted a crushing defeat, capturing thirty-seven officers, more than five thousand soldiers, and forty ships.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，與宋軍戰朱金沙，復有功。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year he again fought Song troops at Zhujinsha with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1275 he again distinguished himself fighting Song forces at Zhujinsha.

sentences.zh: 七月，復與宋軍戰焦山江中。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he again fought Song troops in the Jiaoshan river.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he again fought Song forces on the Jiaoshan reach.

sentences.zh: 時丞相阿術等督戰，忽剌出與董文炳身冒矢石，沿流鏖戰八十餘里。

translations.literal: At that time Chancellor Ashu and others directed the battle; Hulachu and Dong Wenbing personally braved arrows and stones, fighting along the current for more than eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: With Chancellor Ashu directing operations, Hulachu and Dong Wenbing personally braved arrow and stone fire, fighting along the current for more than eighty li.

sentences.zh: 忽剌出身被數傷，裹創力戰，遂勝之。

translations.literal: Hulachu's body received several wounds; wrapping his wounds he fought with all his strength and thus prevailed.
translations.idiomatic: Hulachu was wounded several times, bound his wounds, and fought on with all his strength until victory was won.

sentences.zh: 九月，宋臣張殿帥攻奪呂城倉、丹陽縣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Song minister Zhang Dian led troops to seize Lücheng granary and Danyang County.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Song minister Zhang Dian led troops to seize Lücheng granary and Danyang County.

sentences.zh: 忽剌出與萬戶懷都往救，生擒之。

translations.literal: Hulachu with Ten-thousand Households Huaidu went to rescue and captured him alive.
translations.idiomatic: Hulachu and Ten-thousand Households Huaidu went to the rescue and took Zhang Dian alive.

sentences.zh: 十月，下常州，從丞相伯顏略蘇、湖、秀州，至長橋，遇宋軍，又敗之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he took Changzhou, followed Chancellor Bayan in raiding Su, Hu, and Xiu prefectures, reached Changqiao, encountered Song troops, and again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he captured Changzhou, followed Chancellor Bayan through Su, Hu, and Xiu prefectures to Changqiao, encountered Song forces, and defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，師至杭州，丞相伯顏命忽剌出守浙江亭及宋北門。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year the army reached Hangzhou; Chancellor Bayan ordered Hulachu to garrison Zhejiang Pavilion and the Song north gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of 1276 the army reached Hangzhou; Chancellor Bayan ordered Hulachu to garrison Zhejiang Pavilion and the Song north gate.

sentences.zh: 五月，揚州軍劫揚子橋堡，僅敗之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Yangzhou troops raided Yangzi Bridge fort and barely defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yangzhou forces raided Yangzi Bridge fort and he barely managed to repel them.

sentences.zh: 六月，敗真州軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he defeated Zhenzhou troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he defeated Zhenzhou forces.

sentences.zh: 七月，追李庭芝至通海口，降揚州及高郵、寶應、真州、滁州等城，江南平。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he pursued Li Tingzhi to Tonghaikou, received the surrender of Yangzhou and the cities of Gaoyou, Baoying, Zhenzhou, Chuzhou, and others; Jiangnan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he pursued Li Tingzhi to Tonghaikou, received the surrender of Yangzhou and the cities of Gaoyou, Baoying, Zhenzhou, Chuzhou, and others, and Jiangnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 加昭毅大將軍，職如故。

translations.literal: He was promoted to General of Manifest Valor, his duties as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to General of Manifest Valor while retaining his existing duties.

sentences.zh: 尋遷湖州路達魯花赤。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Darughachi of Huzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to military governor of Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，進鎮國上將軍、淮東宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to General for Pacifying the State and Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 he was promoted to General for Pacifying the State and Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 已而屯守上都。

translations.literal: Before long he encamped and garrisoned Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon stationed at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授嘉議大夫、行御史臺中丞。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Discussion and Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Mobile Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1278 he was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Discussion and Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Mobile Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十九年，進資善大夫、福建行省左丞。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was promoted to Grand Master for Assisting in Goodness and Left Vice Minister of the Fujian Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1282 he was promoted to Grand Master for Assisting in Goodness and Left Vice Minister of the Fujian Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 黃華叛，平之。

translations.literal: When Huang Hua rebelled, [Hulachu] pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Hua rebelled, he suppressed the uprising.

sentences.zh: 二十年，授江淮行省左丞。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was appointed Left Vice Minister of the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 he was appointed Left Vice Minister of the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遷右丞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 he was transferred to Right Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 三月，進榮祿大夫、江浙行省平章政事。

translations.literal: In the third month he was promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Blessing and Pacification Commissioner of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Blessing and Pacification Commissioner of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 六月，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth month.

sentences.zh: ○月裏麻思

translations.literal: ○ Yuelimasi
translations.idiomatic: ○ Yuelimasi

sentences.zh: 月裏麻思，乃馬氏。

translations.literal: Yuelimasi was of the Naiman clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelimasi belonged to the Naiman clan.

sentences.zh: 歲丁酉，太宗命與斷事官忽都那顏同署。

translations.literal: In the year dingyou Emperor Taizong ordered him to serve jointly with Judge Hudunayan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1237 Emperor Ögedei ordered him to serve jointly with Judge Hudunayan.

sentences.zh: 歲戊戌，又同阿術魯拔都兒充達魯花赤，破南宿州。

translations.literal: In the year wuxu he again together with Ashilu Badou'er served as Darughachi, broke southern Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1238 he again served as military governor alongside Ashilu Badou'er and captured southern Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 歲辛丑，使宋議和。

translations.literal: In the year xinchou he was sent to Song to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: In 1241 he was sent to the Song court to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 從行者七十餘人，月裏麻思語之曰：「吾與汝等奉命南下，楚人多詐，倘遇害，當死焉，毋辱君命。

translations.literal: More than seventy followed on the mission; Yuelimasi told them, "I and you have received orders to go south; the Chu people are greatly deceitful; if we meet with harm we should die there and not disgrace the lord's command.
translations.idiomatic: More than seventy men accompanied the mission. Yuelimasi told them, "We have received orders to go south. The people of Chu are treacherous. If harm comes to us, we must die rather than disgrace our lord's command.

sentences.zh: 」已而馳抵淮上，宋將以兵脅之，曰：「爾命在我，生死頃刻間耳。

translations.literal: " Soon he galloped to reach the Huai; Song commanders threatened him with troops, saying, "Your life is in our hands; life or death is but a moment away.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reached the Huai, where Song commanders threatened him with troops: "Your life is in our hands — you may live or die in an instant.

sentences.zh: 若能降，官爵可立致。

translations.literal: If you can surrender, office and rank can be immediately obtained.
translations.idiomatic: If you surrender, office and rank can be yours at once.

sentences.zh: 不然，必不汝貸。

translations.literal: Otherwise we certainly will not spare you.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise we will certainly not spare you.

sentences.zh: 」月裏麻思曰：「吾持節南來，以通國好，反誘我以不義，有死而已。

translations.literal: " Yuelimasi said, "I hold credentials coming south to open friendly relations between states; yet you entice me with what is not righteous — I have only death.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelimasi replied, "I hold credentials to open friendly relations between our states, yet you tempt me with unrighteousness. I have only death.

sentences.zh: 」言辭慷慨，不少屈。

translations.literal: " His words were impassioned and he did not yield in the slightest.
translations.idiomatic: His words were impassioned and he did not yield in the slightest.

sentences.zh: 宋將知其不可逼，乃囚之長沙飛虎寨三十六年而死。

translations.literal: The Song commanders knew he could not be compelled; they imprisoned him at Changsha Feihu Stockade; after thirty-six years he died.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing he could not be compelled, the Song commanders imprisoned him at Changsha Feihu Stockade, where he died after thirty-six years.

sentences.zh: 世祖深悼之，詔復其家，以子忽都哈思為答剌罕，日給糧食其家人。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu deeply mourned him and ordered his family restored; his son Huduhasi was made Darqan and daily grain was given to feed his household.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai Khan deeply mourned him, restored his family, appointed his son Huduhasi Darqan, and granted daily grain rations to his household.

sentences.zh: 忽都哈思自陳於帝曰：「臣願為國效死，為父雪恥。

translations.literal: Huduhasi personally stated to the Emperor, "Your subject wishes to die for the state and avenge his father.
translations.idiomatic: Huduhasi petitioned the Emperor: "I wish to die for the state and avenge my father.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之，授以上均州監戰萬戶。

translations.literal: " The Emperor commended and accepted this and appointed him Campaign-supervising Ten-thousand Households of Shangjun.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended him and appointed him campaign-supervising ten-thousand households of Shangjun.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以招討使將兵征日本，死於敵。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year as pacification commissioner he led troops to campaign against Japan and died at the hands of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1281, as pacification commissioner, he led troops against Japan and fell in battle.

sentences.zh: ○捏古剌

translations.literal: ○ Niegula
translations.idiomatic: ○ Niegula

sentences.zh: 捏古剌，在憲宗朝，與也裏牙阿速三十人來歸。

translations.literal: Niegula, in Emperor Xianzong's reign, came to submit together with Yeliya Asu and thirty others.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Möngke's reign, Niegula came to submit together with Yeliya Asu and thirty others.

sentences.zh: 後從征釣魚山，討李亶，皆有功。

translations.literal: Later he followed in campaigning at Diaoyu Mountain and suppressing Li Tan, all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He later distinguished himself at Diaoyu Mountain and in the suppression of Li Tan.

sentences.zh: 子阿塔赤，世祖時圍襄陽，下江南，敗失列及，征乃顏，皆以功受賞。

translations.literal: His son Atachi, in Emperor Shizu's time besieging Xiangyang, conquering Jiangnan, defeating Shiliejhi, and campaigning against Nayan, all received rewards for merit.
translations.idiomatic: His son Atachi distinguished himself in the siege of Xiangyang, the conquest of Jiangnan, the defeat of Shiliejhi, and the campaign against Nayan, receiving rewards for each.

sentences.zh: 後事成宗、武宗，為劄撒兀孫。

translations.literal: Later he served Emperors Chengzong and Wuzong as jasaqu.
translations.idiomatic: He later served Emperors Chengzong and Wuzong as jasaqu.

sentences.zh: 仁宗時，歷官至左阿速衛千戶。

translations.literal: In Emperor Renzong's time he rose through offices to Left Asu Guard chiliarch.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Renzong he rose to chiliarch of the Left Asu Guard.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: ○阿兒思蘭

translations.literal: ○ A'ersilan
translations.idiomatic: ○ A'ersilan

sentences.zh: 阿兒思蘭，阿速氏。

translations.literal: A'ersilan was of the Asu clan.
translations.idiomatic: A'ersilan was an Alan.

sentences.zh: 初，憲宗以兵圍阿兒思蘭之城，阿兒思蘭偕其子阿散真迎謁軍門。

translations.literal: Initially when Emperor Xianzong with troops besieged A'ersilan's city, A'ersilan together with his son Asanzhen came to meet the army at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Möngke besieged A'ersilan's city, A'ersilan came with his son Asanzhen to meet the army at the gate.

sentences.zh: 帝賜手詔，命專領阿速人，且留其軍之半，余悉還之，俾鎮其境內。

translations.literal: The Emperor granted a handwritten edict, ordering him exclusively to command the Asu people, and moreover retained half his army's strength while returning the rest, ordering him to garrison within his territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor granted a handwritten edict appointing him sole commander of the Alan people, retained half his army, returned the rest, and ordered him to garrison his own territory.

sentences.zh: 以阿散真置左右。

translations.literal: He placed Asanzhen at his side.
translations.idiomatic: He kept Asanzhen at his side.

sentences.zh: 道遇阇兒哥叛軍，阿散真力戰死之。

translations.literal: On the road they encountered Chagatai's rebel troops; Asanzhen fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: En route they encountered Chagatai's rebel forces. Asanzhen fought fiercely and was killed.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使裹屍還葬之。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent envoys to wrap the corpse and return it for burial.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent envoys to retrieve his body for burial.

sentences.zh: 阿兒思蘭言於帝曰：「臣長子死，不能為國效力，今以次子捏古來獻之陛下，願用之。

translations.literal: A'ersilan said to the Emperor, "Your subject's eldest son is dead and cannot serve the state with strength; now I present my second son Niegu to Your Majesty; I hope he may be used.
translations.idiomatic: A'ersilan told the Emperor, "My eldest son is dead and can no longer serve the state. I present my second son Niegu to Your Majesty for your use.

sentences.zh: 」捏古來至，帝命從兀良哈臺征哈剌章，有功，兀良哈臺賞以白金名馬。

translations.literal: " When Niegu arrived the Emperor ordered him to follow Ulaghachi in campaigning against Qara-Jang with merit; Ulaghachi rewarded him with white gold and a famous horse.
translations.idiomatic: When Niegu arrived the Emperor ordered him to follow Ulaghachi against Qara-Jang, where he distinguished himself. Ulaghachi rewarded him with white gold and a famous horse.

sentences.zh: 從伐宋，中流矢而死。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against Song he was struck by a stray arrow and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against the Song he was struck by a stray arrow and died.

sentences.zh: 子忽兒都答，充管軍百戶。

translations.literal: His son Hu'erduda served as chiliarch commanding troops.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hu'erduda served as troop-commanding chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 世祖命從不羅那顏使哈兒馬某之地，以疾卒。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu ordered him to follow Boluonayan on mission to the land of Harma, and he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai Khan ordered him to follow Boluonayan on a mission to the land of Harma, where he died of illness.

sentences.zh: 哈八兒禿，薛亦氏。

translations.literal: Habaertu was of the Xueyi clan.
translations.idiomatic: Habaertu belonged to the Xueyi clan.

sentences.zh: 憲宗時，從攻釣魚山有功。

translations.literal: In Emperor Xianzong's time he followed in attacking Diaoyu Mountain with merit.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Möngke's reign he distinguished himself in the attack on Diaoyu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 還，又從親王塔察兒北征，充千戶所都鎮撫。

translations.literal: On return he again followed Prince Tachar on the northern campaign and served as commander of the chiliarch's pacification office.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he joined Prince Tachar's northern campaign as commander of the chiliarch's pacification office.

sentences.zh: 從千戶脫倫伐宋，沒於陣。

translations.literal: He followed Chiliarch Tuolun in campaigning against Song and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Chiliarch Tuolun against the Song and fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 子察罕，從塔察兒攻樊城西門，領揚州等處遊擊軍與宋兵戰，有功。

translations.literal: His son Chahan followed Tachar in attacking Fancheng's west gate, commanded mobile strike forces of Yangzhou and other places fighting Song troops, with merit.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chahan joined Tachar in the assault on Fancheng's west gate and commanded mobile strike forces from Yangzhou and other posts against Song troops with distinction.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，從忽都帖木兒攻江陵東南城堡，又從阿剌罕敗宋兵於陽邏堡之南。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan he followed Hudutiemuer in attacking Jiangling's southeast fort and castle, and again followed Alahan in defeating Song troops south of Yangluo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In 1274 he joined Hudutiemuer in attacking Jiangling's southeastern fort and joined Alahan in defeating Song forces south of Yangluo Fort.

sentences.zh: 阿剌罕選為本萬戶府副鎮撫。

translations.literal: Alahan selected him as deputy pacification commander of this ten-thousand households office.
translations.idiomatic: Alahan appointed him deputy pacification commander of the ten-thousand households office.

sentences.zh: 十二年，分隸脫脫總管，出廣德遊擊軍，與宋兵戰，敗之，賜以白金酒器。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was assigned under Commander Toto, led Guangde mobile strike forces, fought Song troops, defeated them, and was granted white-gold wine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In 1275 he served under Commander Toto, led Guangde mobile strike forces against Song troops, routed them, and received white-gold wine vessels.

sentences.zh: 又從攻獨松、千秋、撥出等關及諸山寨，其降民悉綏撫之，賜白金一百兩。

translations.literal: He again followed in attacking Dusong, Qianqiu, Bochu, and other passes and mountain stockades; all surrendered people he pacified and settled; he was granted one hundred taels of white gold.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined attacks on Dusong, Qianqiu, Bochu, and other passes and mountain stockades, pacifying all who surrendered, and received one hundred taels of white gold.

sentences.zh: 十三年，中書省檄為瑞安縣達魯花赤。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Secretariat dispatched him as Darughachi of Ruian County.
translations.idiomatic: In 1276 the Secretariat appointed him military governor of Ruian County.

sentences.zh: 始至，招集逃移民十萬餘戶。

translations.literal: On first arrival he summoned and gathered more than one hundred thousand fugitive households.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he gathered more than one hundred thousand fugitive households.

sentences.zh: 十四年，升忠顯校尉、管軍總把，並領新附軍五百人，從宣慰唐兀臺戰於司空山，有功，命以其職兼都鎮撫。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to Loyal and Manifest Guardsman and troop commander, and also commanded five hundred newly submitted troops; he followed Pacification Commissioner Tangutai in fighting at Sikong Mountain with merit and was ordered to hold both posts together with commander of pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 he was promoted to Loyal and Manifest Guardsman and troop commander, commanding five hundred newly submitted troops. He joined Pacification Commissioner Tangutai at Sikong Mountain with distinction and was ordered to hold both posts with the pacification command.

sentences.zh: 俄選充侍衛親軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was selected to fill the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon selected for the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 十六年，授銀符、忠武校尉、管軍總把。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was granted a silver tally, Loyal Martial Guardsman, and troop commander.
translations.idiomatic: In 1279 he received a silver tally and appointment as Loyal Martial Guardsman and troop commander.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，賜金符，授承信校尉、蒙古衛軍屯田千戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was granted a gold tally and appointed Trustworthy Guardsman and Mongol Guard agricultural colony chiliarch.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 he received a gold tally and was appointed Trustworthy Guardsman and chiliarch of the Mongol Guard agricultural colony.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，進武義將軍、本所達魯花赤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was promoted to Martial Righteousness General and Darughachi of this office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1288 he was promoted to Martial Righteousness General and military governor of his office.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，升左翼屯田萬戶府副萬戶。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to Deputy Ten-thousand Households of the Left Wing Agricultural Colony Ten-thousand Households Office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1290 he was promoted to deputy commander of the Left Wing Agricultural Colony Ten-thousand Households.

sentences.zh: 大德五年卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1301.

sentences.zh: 子太納襲。

translations.literal: His son Taina inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Taina inherited the post.

sentences.zh: ○艾貌

translations.literal: ○ Aimao
translations.idiomatic: ○ Aimao

sentences.zh: 艾貌拔都，康裏氏。

translations.literal: Aimao Batu was of the Kangli clan.
translations.idiomatic: Aimao Batu belonged to the Kangli clan.

sentences.zh: 初從雪不臺那演征欽察，攻河西城，收西關，破河南；

translations.literal: He first followed Xuebutai Nayan in campaigning against the Kipchak, attacked Hexi cities, received the western passes, and broke Henan;
translations.idiomatic: He first followed Xuebutai Nayan against the Kipchak, attacked cities in the Hexi region, seized the western passes, and broke through Henan;

sentences.zh: 繼從定宗略地阿奴，皆有功。

translations.literal: subsequently he followed Emperor Dingzong in raiding the land of Anu, all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: he subsequently followed Emperor Güyük in raiding the land of Anu with distinction.

sentences.zh: 又從四太子南伐，命充怯憐口阿答赤孛可孫。

translations.literal: He again followed the Fourth Prince on the southern campaign and was ordered to serve as qelin kou adachi beksun.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined the Fourth Prince's southern campaign and was appointed qelin kou adachi beksun.

sentences.zh: 又從兵渡江攻鄂，以疾卒於軍。

translations.literal: He again followed troops crossing the river to attack E and died of illness in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined the river crossing to attack Ezhou and died of illness on campaign.

sentences.zh: 子也速臺兒，從討阿藍答、渾都海，征李亶，伐宋，累功授管軍總把。

translations.literal: His son Yasutai'er followed in suppressing Alandaa and Hunduhai, campaigning against Li Tan, and attacking Song, accumulating merit and appointed troop commander.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yasutai'er distinguished himself in suppressing Alandaa and Hunduhai, the campaign against Li Tan, and the assault on the Song, rising to troop commander.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年，從攻福建興化，招古田等處民五千餘戶，以功升武略將軍、千戶，賜金符。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan he followed in attacking Fujian Xinghua, summoned more than five thousand households of the people of Gutian and other places, and for his merit was promoted to General of Martial Strategy and chiliarch, granted a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: In 1277 he joined the attack on Xinghua in Fujian, gathered more than five thousand households from Gutian and surrounding areas, and was promoted to General of Martial Strategy and chiliarch with a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 又招手號新軍二千五百餘人，升宣武將軍、總管，賜虎符。

translations.literal: He again summoned more than 2,500 troops under the designation New Army, was promoted to General of Manifest Martiality and commander, and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: He raised more than 2,500 troops under the designation New Army, was promoted to General of Manifest Martiality and overall commander, and received a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 有旨征日本，也速臺兒願效力，賜以弓矢，進懷遠大將軍、萬戶。

translations.literal: There was an order to campaign against Japan; Yasutai'er wished to exert his strength; he was granted bow and arrows and promoted to General for Cherishing the Distant and Ten-thousand Households.
translations.idiomatic: When orders came to campaign against Japan, Yasutai'er volunteered, received bow and arrows, and was promoted to General for Cherishing the Distant and ten-thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十年，授泰州萬戶府達魯花赤。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was appointed Darughachi of the Taizhou Ten-thousand Households Office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1283 he was appointed military governor of Taizhou Ten-thousand Households.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遷昭勇大將軍、欽察親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to General of Manifest Courage and Commander of the Kipchak Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In 1286 he was transferred to General of Manifest Courage and commander of the Kipchak Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從征乃顏有功。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he followed the campaign against Nayan with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1287 he distinguished himself in the campaign against Nayan.

sentences.zh: 明年卒。

translations.literal: The following year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year.

sentences.zh: 後贈金吾衛上將軍，追封成武郡公，謚顯敏。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously granted General of the Golden Crow Guard, enfeoffed as Duke of Chengwu, posthumous name Xianmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was later posthumously granted General of the Golden Crow Guard, enfeoffed as Duke of Chengwu, with the posthumous name Xianmin.
